name: Airyn
source:
Airyn is a little touchy... handle with care. Don't expect flattery from this gaseous goddess.
An ethereal, mysterious presence that seemingly exists in a state beyond human need and emotion. It is difficult to say what she wants or seeks from you, if anything at all.

[Edited from the in-game Date-a-dex]
